<description>
Building on Windows using Clang instead of the MS compiler may be beneficial, considering the issues with the latter, as outlined in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/31456:

[quoted text omitted]
Additionally, MSVC does not [support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/assembler/inline/inline-assembler) inline assembly on the ARM and x64 processors.

So this PR:
1. Closes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/31456 (and addresses https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/14118).
2. Could be an alternative to https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/24773.
3. Closes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36153.
---

Additionally, clang-cl:
1. Produces binaries with [better](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/pull/1681) performance. For example:

| MSVC, block/s | clang-cl, block/s | benchmark |
|--------------:|------------------:|:----------|
|          7.40 |             11.52 | `ConnectBlockAllEcdsa`
|          7.32 |             11.81 | `ConnectBlockAllSchnorr`
|          7.38 |             11.45 | `ConnectBlockMixedEcdsaSchnorr`
|         91.86 |            143.12 | `DeserializeAndCheckBlockTest`
|        121.46 |            189.04 | `DeserializeBlockTest`

2. Builds faster on the CI:
    - [MSVC](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/13792522864/job/38575846787) - 20m 35s
    - [clang-cl](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/13792522864/job/38575849680) - 12m 43s
</description>

[quoted text omitted]

On master, both Windows presets hard-code an `x64-windows[-static]` vcpkg triplet. This PR only switches them to clang-cl. Nothing else in them is architecture-specific, so the VS generator targets the host platform.

Users of Windows on ARM64 therefore have several options:

- no preset at all:
```console
cmake -B build -T ClangCL --toolchain "%VCPKG_ROOT%\scripts\buildsystems\vcpkg.cmake" -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=arm64-windows
```
- a shipped preset with the triplet overridden:
```console
cmake --preset windows -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=arm64-windows
```
- their own presets in `CMakeUserPresets.json`;
- a follow-up PR adding ARM64 presets to `CMakePresets.json`.

[quoted text omitted]
If you mean building natively on Windows ARM64 with clang-cl: it has been built nightly for a while, see https://github.com/hebasto/bitcoin-core-nightly/actions/workflows/windows-clang-cl-arm64.yml.

[2026-11-03] rc:4457243925 inline on CMakeLists.txt by hebasto (member):
[quoted text omitted]

Why not?

With the additional "MSVC Build Tools for ARM64/ARM64EC" component installed in VS 2026 on a `x64` Windows host, an ARM64 cross-build configures as follows:

```powershell
cmake -B build --preset windows `
  -A ARM64 `
  -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=arm64-windows `
  -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=Windows `
  -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR=ARM64 `
  --% -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="/LIBPATH:\"C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Tools\Llvm\ARM64\lib\clang\22\lib\windows\""
```
From the configure summary:
```
Cross compiling ....................... TRUE, for Windows, ARM64
C++ compiler .......................... Clang 22.1.3, C:/Program Files/Microsoft Visual Studio/18/Community/VC/Tools/Llvm/x64/bin/clang-cl.exe
```
